name: jev-compact
description: Before LimitSwitcher swaps a Claude Code session to another account, shrinks the tool outputs it no longer needs with TypeSafe's Jev (through OpenRouter), so the new account loads less. Everything else stays verbatim; no Claude usage.

envFile.title: LimitSwitcher .env file
envFile.description: A file with an OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... line (set when LimitSwitcher installs this mod). The OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable, or Claude Code's settings.json env block, also works.

manual.title: Also prune on /compact
manual.description: Off: only LimitSwitcher's compaction before a swap uses Jev, and /compact and auto-compaction stay Claude Code's own. On: /compact prunes with Jev too (and falls back to Claude Code's summary when Jev can't).

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: At or above this Jev probability (0 to 1) that an output is still needed, it stays whole.

stubThreshold.title: Stub threshold
stubThreshold.description: Below this probability an output becomes a one-line note; between the two thresholds it keeps its head and tail.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages are never touched (nor the first one).
